title: Test Plan Generator
description: Physics-based test plans from mission profile to DVP&R.
whenToUse: When you need a defensible validation plan tied to mechanisms, stressors, and reliability targets.

title: Mission Profile Builder
description: Build duty-cycle and stress distributions by lifecycle phase, with a clickable matrix and exports.

title: HALT/HASS Planning Wizard
description: Build HALT step-stress profiles and derive HASS production screens.
whenToUse: When you need to discover design margins fast and translate learnings into production screening.

title: Burn-In Test Wizard
description: Design physics-based burn-in: stress conditions, duration and acceleration factors.
whenToUse: When screening early-life failures or accelerating infant mortality detection.

title: Vibration + Thermal Cycling Wizard
description: Turn mission vibration profiles into accelerated PSD tests and fixture requirements.
whenToUse: When translating mission vibration and thermal profiles into accelerated qualification tests.

title: Derating Navigator
description: Apply MIL-style derating to components and quantify margins and thermal headroom.
whenToUse: When preventing overstress failures before hardware is built or tested.

title: Arrhenius Calculator
description: Calculate thermal acceleration factors, equivalent life and ALT test durations.
whenToUse: When temperature-driven aging dominates failure risk.

title: Weibull Probability Plot
description: Fit 2-parameter Weibull to failure and suspension data; get beta, eta and B-lives.
whenToUse: When estimating life distributions, B10 targets, and mission reliability from life test data.

title: Coffin-Manson Calculator
description: Estimate thermal-cycling fatigue life for solder joints and interconnects.
whenToUse: When cyclic strain drive mechanical or solder fatigue.

title: Electromigration Lifetime Calculator
description: Predict interconnect MTTF with Black's equation from current density and temperature.
whenToUse: When electromigration limits IC or metallization reliability.

title: Sample Size Calculator
description: Size a test by what it must prove: success run, MTBF, Weibayes, A/B and more.
whenToUse: When planning any reliability test — demonstration, life characterisation, margin, HALT or HASS screening.

title: Psychrometric Calculator
description: Compute RH, wet-bulb, dew point and enthalpy for humidity testing and lab conditions.
whenToUse: When chamber settings or moisture exposure affect reliability outcomes.

title: P Diagram Generator
description: Structure signals, noise factors, and design intent.
whenToUse: When defining validation scope early in the design cycle.

title: Reliability Block Diagram (RBD) Generator
description: Build series/parallel Reliability Block Diagrams and compute system reliability.
whenToUse: When system-level reliability depends on configuration, not parts alone.

title: Bayesian Reliability Predictor (Software)
description: Estimate and update software reliability, MTTF and release readiness with Bayesian methods.
whenToUse: When incorporating test or field failures into decision-making.

title: FIT Calculator
description: Convert FIT, failure rate, ppm and MTTF, and check a test supports a FIT claim.
whenToUse: When a supplier or team cites a FIT number and you need to know what it means over the real mission and whether the test evidence backs it.

title: NUDD Assessment
description: Score what is New, Unique, Different and Difficult to focus engineering effort.
whenToUse: During concept selection, design reviews, DRBFM/change-point discussions, or DFMEA prep and test-strategy planning.
